sql: INSERT INTO api_tokens (user_id, name, token_hash, scope, created_at, expires_at, revoked_at) SELECT ?1, ?2, ?3, ?4, ?5, NULLIF(?6, ''), NULL WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users WHERE id = ?1 AND role = ?7 AND disabled_at IS NULL) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM settings u, settings e WHERE u.key = ?8 AND u.value_json = ?1 AND e.key = ?9 AND CAST(e.value_json AS INTEGER) > ?5) RETURNING id

params:
cli-agent
scope	writer
user	$user
via	cli
sql: INSERT INTO system_log (at_ms, request_id, kind, actor_id, error_code, detail) SELECT ?1, ?2, ?3, NULL, NULL, ?4 WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM api_tokens WHERE token_hash = ?5)
